name: Estimation
description: Estimate unknown quantities from data and say how far off you might be.

lessonNames.l10-catching-the-truth: A range that catches the truth

lessonObjectives.l1-sample-population: Tell a statistic from the parameter it estimates.
lessonObjectives.l2-estimates-vary: See the sampling distribution of the mean by simulation.
lessonObjectives.l3-right-target: Show why dividing by $n - 1$ makes the variance estimator unbiased.
lessonObjectives.l4-bias-against-variance: Compare estimators by mean squared error.
lessonObjectives.l5-which-fits: Write a likelihood and read it as a function of the parameter.
lessonObjectives.l6-maximising: Derive the maximum likelihood estimate for a coin and for a normal mean.
lessonObjectives.l7-taking-logs: Use the log-likelihood to turn a product into a sum.
lessonObjectives.l8-volatility-mle: Estimate volatility from returns by maximum likelihood.
lessonObjectives.l9-how-precise: Compute and interpret a standard error.
lessonObjectives.l10-catching-the-truth: Build a 95% confidence interval and say exactly what the 95% means.
lessonObjectives.l11-bootstrap: Build a bootstrap confidence interval in code.
lessonObjectives.l12-updating-a-belief: Update a beta prior with coin flips and compare it with the maximum likelihood estimate.
